serverless_active_per_hr.note: Not published. docs.runpod.io/serverless/pricing says active workers are always running and 'Discounts available through sales inquiry'. The cost model uses the flex rate times ACTIVE_DISCOUNT (default 1.0, i.e. no discount) until a real quote exists.

pod_on_demand_per_hr.note: As listed on the pricing page Pods table. The page does not say which cloud tier (Secure/Community) each figure is; check the console's deploy screen before quoting.

billing_rules_quoted: Serverless: billed from when a worker starts until it fully stops, rounded up to the nearest second.
Workers incur charges during start time, execution time and idle timeout (default 5 s).
Cached models: you aren't billed for worker time while the model is being downloaded.
